description: Prompt text and metadata only, keyed by id. Maps 1:1 with prompts-images.json.

convenience-store-neon-portrait.title: Convenience Store Neon Portrait
convenience-store-neon-portrait.prompt: 35mm film photography with harsh convenience store fluorescent lighting mixed with colorful neon signs from outside, authentic film grain, high contrast, slight color cast, cinematic street editorial style, intimate medium shot, early 20s woman with ultra-realistic delicate features, seductive almond-shaped eyes with natural double eyelids, high nose bridge, small sharp V-shaped jawline, flawless porcelain skin with cool ivory undertone and visible specular highlights from fluorescent light, subtle skin texture and micro pores, natural dewy makeup with soft flush on cheeks, glossy natural pink lips slightly parted, long dark hair in a messy high ponytail with loose strands falling around face, wearing an oversized white button-up shirt loosely tied at the waist, paired with a tiny black pleated mini skirt, seductive casual leaning pose against the glass door of a 24-hour convenience store at late night, bright cold fluorescent store light from inside mixed with pink and blue neon glow from outside signs, realistic reflections on glass door, blurred convenience store interior in background, authentic 35mm film color grading, no plastic skin, no watermark, no text
convenience-store-neon-portrait.negative_prompt: no plastic skin, no watermark, no text
convenience-store-neon-portrait.tip: Best with 9:16 output. Keep fluorescent + neon contrast strong; avoid plastic-skin fixes.
convenience-store-neon-portrait.tip_zh: 推荐 9:16 出图，保留荧光与霓虹对比，避免肌肤过度磨皮。
convenience-store-neon-portrait.author: @BubbleBrain

boston-spring-2026-city-poster.title: Boston Spring 2026 City Poster
boston-spring-2026-city-poster.title_zh: 波士顿春日 2026 城市海报
boston-spring-2026-city-poster.prompt: A striking Spring 2026 city poster for Boston with an elegant celebratory mood and a bold contemporary design. On a clean off-white textured background with large areas of negative space, a miniature single sculler rows across the lower right corner of the image on a narrow ribbon of reflective water. The wake from the oar sweeps upward in a dynamic calligraphic curve, gradually transforming into the Charles River and then into a dreamlike hand-painted panorama of Boston. Inside this flowing river-shaped composition are iconic Boston elements: the Back Bay skyline, Beacon Hill brownstones, Acorn Street, Boston Public Garden, Swan Boats, Zakim Bridge, Fenway-inspired details, historic brick architecture, harbor ferries, and the city's waterfront atmosphere. Soft morning fog, golden spring light, subtle festive accents in crimson and gold, rich detail, layered depth, sophisticated city-poster aesthetics, fresh and refined, visually powerful but not overcrowded. Elegant typography in the lower left reads 'SPRING 2026' with a vertical slogan 'BOSTON, A CITY OF RIVER, MEMORY, AND INVENTION', text clear and beautifully composed, premium graphic design, 9:16
boston-spring-2026-city-poster.tip: Render at high quality so 'SPRING 2026' typography stays crisp. Keep negative space generous.
boston-spring-2026-city-poster.tip_zh: 高质量出图保证文字 'SPRING 2026' 清晰，留白要够大。
boston-spring-2026-city-poster.author: @EvoLinkAI

amalfi-coast-vintage-travel-poster.title: Vintage Amalfi Coast Travel Poster
amalfi-coast-vintage-travel-poster.title_zh: 复古阿马尔菲海岸旅行海报
amalfi-coast-vintage-travel-poster.prompt: Modern pencil illustration of a vintage travel poster depicting the Amalfi Coast, Italy, panoramic coastal cliff road scene, classic 1960s white car driving along a curved seaside road, deep blue Mediterranean sea with small sailboats, colorful pastel hillside village, bright blue sky with soft clouds, lemon tree branches with vibrant yellow lemons framing the foreground, warm summer sunlight, bold vibrant colors, retro 1950s travel poster style, cinematic composition, high detail, screen print texture, graphic illustration. Hand-drawn style with loose strokes and defined contours. High-contrast color palette, contemporary and decorative aesthetic.
amalfi-coast-vintage-travel-poster.tip: Lock subject = 'Amalfi Coast' and reference '1950s travel poster' for the right gouache feel.
amalfi-coast-vintage-travel-poster.tip_zh: 强调 1950s travel poster + 丝网印质感，避免被现代插画覆盖。
amalfi-coast-vintage-travel-poster.author: @EvoLinkAI

adventure-character-design-sheet.title: Adventure Character Design Sheet
adventure-character-design-sheet.title_zh: 冒险角色三视图设定稿
adventure-character-design-sheet.prompt: Create a detailed character design sheet for Lira, a young female explorer-mechanic-inventor in her early 20s. Include front, side, and back turnaround views in T-pose. She wears an olive-green fur-lined parka with copper buckles, a golden hand-knit scarf, leather utility belt with brass tools and small gears, weathered cargo trousers, and worn brown leather boots. Add an array of six expressive facial expressions in a top row (curious, determined, surprised, thoughtful, mischievous, proud). Include an equipment breakdown panel: brass goggles, leather-bound journal, hand-cranked lantern, and a compact mechanical wing-pack. Bottom corner: small thumbnail of a snowy mountain village at dusk where she lives. Clean off-white parchment background with pencil grid guidelines, soft watercolor wash, refined ink linework, character sheet typography labels in elegant serif, professional concept art style, 16:9.
adventure-character-design-sheet.tip: Lock the spec lists (clothes, expressions, equipment) — gpt-image-2 follows them strictly.
adventure-character-design-sheet.tip_zh: 明确写出服装/表情/装备清单，gpt-image-2 会逐项渲染。
adventure-character-design-sheet.author: @BubbleBrain

summer-citrus-soda-ad.title: Summer Citrus Soda Ad
summer-citrus-soda-ad.prompt: Product advertising photo, seasonal summer product, carbonated beverage, name='Summer Citrus SODA', shape=500ml plastic bottle, research 2025 high-CTR drink ad designs and generate accordingly, aspect ratio 3:4
summer-citrus-soda-ad.tip: Short prompt — the model researches its own composition. Iterate the bottle name to brand it.
summer-citrus-soda-ad.tip_zh: 提示词极短，靠模型自己研究画面。改瓶身文字即可换品牌。
summer-citrus-soda-ad.author: @Anil-matcha

saas-dashboard-dark-mode.title: SaaS Analytics Dashboard (Dark Mode)
saas-dashboard-dark-mode.prompt: A SaaS analytics dashboard in dark mode. Charcoal background (#1a1a2e) with cards showing: a line chart of monthly revenue in gradient green, a donut chart of traffic sources, a data table of top products, and KPI cards with up/down trend arrows. Sidebar navigation on the left with icons. Subtle glass-morphism effect on cards, Inter font, 8px border radius throughout. High-fidelity UI mockup, pixel-clean rendering, accurate typography, 16:9.
saas-dashboard-dark-mode.tip: Spell out font + radius + hex bg. gpt-image-2 renders crisper text than other models.
saas-dashboard-dark-mode.tip_zh: 明确字体、圆角、背景色。gpt-image-2 文字渲染特别清晰，写细一些就行。
saas-dashboard-dark-mode.author: gptimage2ai.com

meditation-app-onboarding.title: Meditation App Onboarding Screen
meditation-app-onboarding.prompt: A mobile app onboarding screen design for a meditation app. Clean, calming layout with a large illustration of a person meditating on a cloud at the top half. Below: a headline 'Find Your Inner Peace', a brief description in light gray text, pagination dots showing screen 2 of 4, and a rounded 'Continue' button in soft lavender. White background, ample whitespace, Inter font. Pixel-perfect mobile UI mockup, 9:16, iPhone 15 Pro device frame optional.
meditation-app-onboarding.tip: Specify exact headline copy in single quotes — text rendering will follow.
meditation-app-onboarding.tip_zh: 用单引号锁定标题文案，文字会被准确渲染。
meditation-app-onboarding.author: gptimage2ai.com

subway-candid-iphone.title: Subway Candid iPhone Photo
subway-candid-iphone.prompt: Create a completely RAW quality, unprocessed, unedited image with full iPhone camera quality. A subway station in USA at night, a beautiful young woman in a long black coat standing near the closing doors looking at her phone, slight motion blur, fluorescent ceiling lights, mild lens flare, natural skin tones, no beauty filter, candid composition, slight handheld tilt, authentic everyday atmosphere, 4:3.
subway-candid-iphone.negative_prompt: no beauty filter, no over-saturation, no professional lighting
subway-candid-iphone.tip: Keywords 'RAW', 'unprocessed', 'no beauty filter' are what unlock the realistic look.
subway-candid-iphone.tip_zh: 关键词 RAW / unprocessed / no beauty filter 是出真实感的关键。
subway-candid-iphone.author: @WolfRiccardo

futuristic-mandala-cyberpunk.title: Futuristic Cyberpunk Mandala
futuristic-mandala-cyberpunk.prompt: A near-future sci-fi version of a mandala — intricate geometric patterns mixed with holographic and cyberpunk aesthetics, glowing neon lines in cyan, magenta, and electric violet, deep starfield background with subtle nebula, ultra-detailed symmetrical design, fine line precision, faint hexagonal grid overlay, sacred-geometry-meets-tech feel, premium digital art, 1:1.
futuristic-mandala-cyberpunk.tip: Reinforce 'symmetrical' twice; gpt-image-2 still occasionally drifts on perfect mirror symmetry.
futuristic-mandala-cyberpunk.tip_zh: 重复强调 symmetrical，gpt-image-2 偶尔会偏对称。
futuristic-mandala-cyberpunk.author: @EvoLinkAI

scifi-inventor-teaser-poster.title: Sci-Fi Movie Teaser Poster: INVENTOR
scifi-inventor-teaser-poster.prompt: Create a cinematic sci-fi movie teaser poster in 16:9 landscape format. A lone woman stands in silhouette at the edge of an enormous cubic chamber filled with hundreds of glowing holographic data screens that float in concentric rings around her. Cool cyan and amber rim light. A faint particle haze drifts through the air. Title 'INVENTOR' in wide-spaced uppercase serif typography across the top, with a tagline 'DISCOVERY IS JUST THE BEGINNING' below in small letter-spaced sans-serif. Bottom credits block in tiny condensed type. Premium movie-poster grading, deep blacks, cinematic key art quality, 16:9.
scifi-inventor-teaser-poster.tip: Wrap title and tagline in single quotes. gpt-image-2 nails letter-spacing when asked.
scifi-inventor-teaser-poster.tip_zh: 标题和 tagline 用单引号包起来，字距能精确控制。
scifi-inventor-teaser-poster.author: @EvoLinkAI

vintage-tokyo-jazz-club-poster.title: Vintage Tokyo Jazz Club Poster
vintage-tokyo-jazz-club-poster.title_zh: 复古东京爵士俱乐部海报
vintage-tokyo-jazz-club-poster.prompt:
Vintage 1960s music poster for a Tokyo jazz club, hand-drawn lithograph style,
saxophone player silhouette against deep teal background, warm mustard accents,
bold sans-serif Japanese-English bilingual title "TOKYO BLUE NOTE", visible paper grain,
slight ink misregistration, off-white margins. No photorealism. High-contrast print look.
vintage-tokyo-jazz-club-poster.negative_prompt: no modern fonts, no gradients, no glossy finish
vintage-tokyo-jazz-club-poster.tip: Specify a print era (e.g. '1960s lithograph') to lock the texture and color treatment; ask for 'ink misregistration' to get authentic vintage feel.
vintage-tokyo-jazz-club-poster.tip_zh: 指定具体年代和印刷工艺（如 1960s lithograph）能稳定锁住纹理与配色，加 "ink misregistration" 更复古。
vintage-tokyo-jazz-club-poster.author: Capy

minimalist-skincare-bottle-marble.title: Minimalist Skincare Bottle on Marble
minimalist-skincare-bottle-marble.title_zh: 极简护肤品瓶大理石场景
minimalist-skincare-bottle-marble.prompt:
Studio product photo of an unbranded matte ceramic skincare bottle on a polished white Carrara marble surface,
soft directional window light from upper-left casting a long subtle shadow,
single sprig of fresh green eucalyptus leaning against the bottle, pure white seamless backdrop fading behind,
shallow depth of field, hyper-clean editorial aesthetic, photographed with 100mm macro lens.
minimalist-skincare-bottle-marble.negative_prompt: no logo, no text, no harsh reflections, no glossy bottle
minimalist-skincare-bottle-marble.tip: Ask for a specific lens focal length (e.g. 100mm macro) and a window-light direction to lock professional studio realism.
minimalist-skincare-bottle-marble.tip_zh: 指定镜头焦段（如 100mm 微距）和窗光方向，写真感更稳定。
minimalist-skincare-bottle-marble.author: Capy

isometric-cozy-coffee-shop-3d.title: Isometric Cozy Coffee Shop
isometric-cozy-coffee-shop-3d.prompt:
Isometric 3D illustration of a cozy two-story coffee shop cutaway, warm afternoon sunlight
streaming through bay windows, exposed brick walls, hanging Edison bulbs, espresso machine on the counter,
bookshelf with potted plants, baristas working, two customers reading, second floor with a study nook,
soft pastel palette of cream / terracotta / sage green, sharp clean linework, subtle ambient occlusion.
isometric-cozy-coffee-shop-3d.negative_prompt: no photorealism, no harsh shadows, no signage text
isometric-cozy-coffee-shop-3d.tip: Specify time-of-day ('warm afternoon sunlight') and a single dominant pastel palette to keep the scene cohesive.
isometric-cozy-coffee-shop-3d.tip_zh: 注明时间段（warm afternoon sunlight）+ 一个主导色系，避免画面发花。
isometric-cozy-coffee-shop-3d.author: Capy

cyberpunk-mech-pilot-character-sheet.title: Cyberpunk Mech Pilot Character Sheet
cyberpunk-mech-pilot-character-sheet.title_zh: 赛博朋克机甲驾驶员角色设定
cyberpunk-mech-pilot-character-sheet.prompt:
Character design sheet for a young Asian female mech pilot, age 22, sharp facial features,
undercut bob with neon teal streaks, full-body armored flightsuit with exposed joint cabling,
glowing visor helmet held in one hand, holstered sidearm, scuffed boots,
three-pose turnaround on neutral mid-grey background (front / 3/4 / back),
labeled callouts pointing to gear details, soft studio key light, semi-realistic stylized rendering.
cyberpunk-mech-pilot-character-sheet.negative_prompt: no anime cuteness, no oversexualization, no realistic celebrity face
cyberpunk-mech-pilot-character-sheet.tip: Always ask for a turnaround layout and label callouts — gpt-image-2 packs them naturally on a single canvas.
cyberpunk-mech-pilot-character-sheet.tip_zh: 让模型直接画三视图 + 标注引线，比单张更适合做角色 ref。
cyberpunk-mech-pilot-character-sheet.author: Capy

crypto-trading-app-dark-mode-ui.title: Crypto Trading App Dark Mode UI
crypto-trading-app-dark-mode-ui.title_zh: 加密交易 App 深色模式界面
crypto-trading-app-dark-mode-ui.prompt:
Mobile app UI screenshot for a crypto trading platform in dark mode, iPhone 15 Pro frame,
portfolio screen at top showing total balance "$28,450.32" and 24h change "+4.21%" in mint green,
candlestick chart for BTC/USD, asset list below with rows for ETH, SOL, ADA each with sparkline,
bottom tab bar with 5 icons (Home, Markets, Trade, Wallet, Profile),
flat modern design, generous spacing, monospace numerals for prices, status bar showing 9:41,
no gradients, sharp 1x rendering, high pixel fidelity.
crypto-trading-app-dark-mode-ui.negative_prompt: no Apple logo, no real exchange branding, no blurry text
crypto-trading-app-dark-mode-ui.tip: Provide concrete sample numbers and asset symbols — vague prompts produce illegible placeholder text.
crypto-trading-app-dark-mode-ui.tip_zh: 把数字、币种缩写都写清楚，避免出现糊掉的占位文字。
crypto-trading-app-dark-mode-ui.author: Capy
